During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''fungal growth''' was discovered that, when it infected [[Droid/Legends|droids]], eroded them from the inside out.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Fishing for Trouble}}</ref>
